value.rationale: The object is a natural complete-twin blowup of a classical fan. The theorem yields an exact labelled minimal-set classification and all coefficients via a fixed 9-state transfer process rather than an extremal minimum alone. The exact pure/nonpure boundary n=3 or m=2,n in {4,6} exhibits structural re-entry and shows that minimal geodetic-set sizes cease to be uniform throughout a broad infinite family.
